The only notable risks are explicitly documented design limitations: wrapping fee-on-transfer/deflationary or rebasing tokens can desynchronize totalSupply vs. underlying balance and potentially cause undercollateralization/withdrawal failures. Those behaviors depend on the underlying token’s economics and are not an exploit in this wrapper code itself.
